title: So-so Espresso machine
text: So-so Espresso machine. Not knowing what the price will be on this Espresso machine by Singolo makes it difficult to accurately review it. If it goes for less than $100, it may be worth the money (but I think this is unlikely). Positives: coffee comes out great and the unit is easy to use. Negatives: this machine is huge (heightwise)and makes it difficult to find a place to keep out on my countertop (I actually had to store it in my hall closet). I also have a Delonghi Espresso Machine, which I purchased on Amazon, that I really prefer to the Singolo. And, as the other reviewer had stated, it is disappointing to find that this unit is actually made in China (and not Italy).
